# teams_app_permission_policy (Resource)

Manages the AppPermissionPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsAppPermissionPolicy / Get-CsTeamsAppPermissionPolicy / Set-CsTeamsAppPermissionPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsAppPermissionPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `default_catalog_apps` (String) Maps to the -DefaultCatalogApps parameter.
- `default_catalog_apps_type` (String) Maps to the -DefaultCatalogAppsType parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `global_catalog_apps` (String) Maps to the -GlobalCatalogApps parameter.
- `global_catalog_apps_type` (String) Maps to the -GlobalCatalogAppsType parameter.
- `private_catalog_apps` (String) Maps to the -PrivateCatalogApps parameter.
- `private_catalog_apps_type` (String) Maps to the -PrivateCatalogAppsType parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
